missions.title: Listen First

missions.title: Say What You Appreciate

missions.title: Ask & Listen

missions.title: Unexpected Kindness

missions.title: Lighten the Load

missions.title: Show Up

missions.title: Take the First Step
missions.instruction: Start one respectful conversation that could ease a recent misunderstanding or tension.

missions.title: Own Your Part
missions.instruction: Think about one recent disagreement and acknowledge your part without immediately defending yourself.
missions.why: Healthy relationships grow when we learn to reconnect, repair hurt and move forward with care.

missions.title: Reconnect
missions.instruction: Take one genuine step toward someone important you've become unnecessarily distant from.
missions.why: Healthy relationships grow when we learn to reconnect, repair hurt and move forward with care.

missions.title: Protect Tonight
missions.instruction: Choose a realistic bedtime tonight that gives your body a proper opportunity to recover.

missions.title: Recovery 20

missions.why: Protecting rest and recovery gives the body and brain the foundation they need to function well.

missions.title: Listen to Your Body
missions.instruction: Notice one genuine signal of fatigue today and respond with an appropriate recovery action.
missions.why: Protecting rest and recovery gives the body and brain the foundation they need to function well.

missions.title: Move 20
missions.instruction: Complete at least 20 minutes of intentional physical activity today.
missions.why: Regular movement builds physical capability, energy and confidence in what the body can do.

missions.title: Movement Snacks
missions.instruction: Take three separate five-minute movement breaks during your day.
missions.why: Regular movement builds physical capability, energy and confidence in what the body can do.

missions.title: Move Instead
missions.instruction: Replace one sedentary opportunity with walking, stretching, stairs, sport or another suitable form of movement.
missions.why: Regular movement builds physical capability, energy and confidence in what the body can do.

missions.title: Upgrade One Meal
missions.instruction: Make one meal today noticeably more supportive of your health and energy.

missions.title: Hydrate Deliberately
missions.instruction: Keep water accessible and intentionally hydrate throughout the day.
missions.why: Practising nourishing choices builds responsibility for the fuel and hydration the body needs.

missions.title: Beat Convenience
missions.instruction: For one meal or snack, choose a healthier practical option instead of automatically choosing what is easiest.
missions.why: Practising nourishing choices builds responsibility for the fuel and hydration the body needs.

missions.title: Reset for Five
missions.instruction: When stress rises today, take a deliberate five-minute reset before continuing.
missions.why: Learning to settle the body and emotions helps us respond better when stress or strong feelings appear.

missions.title: Name the Pressure
missions.instruction: Identify your biggest current source of stress and one practical action that could reduce it.
missions.why: Learning to settle the body and emotions helps us respond better when stress or strong feelings appear.

missions.title: Healthy Release
missions.instruction: Use walking, breathing, stretching, exercise, journaling, quiet time or another healthy strategy after a stressful period.
missions.why: Learning to settle the body and emotions helps us respond better when stress or strong feelings appear.

missions.title: Stop Postponing It
missions.instruction: Take one practical next step on a health need you have been putting off.

missions.title: Prevention Check
missions.instruction: Review one appropriate preventive-health need and take the next step if it is due.
missions.why: Small health and safety actions build responsibility for caring for the body before problems grow.

missions.title: Protect Future You
missions.instruction: Improve one everyday routine that could protect your long-term health.
missions.why: Small health and safety actions build responsibility for caring for the body before problems grow.

missions.title: Know Your Numbers
missions.instruction: Spend 10 minutes reviewing where your money went over the last seven days.
missions.why: Noticing and caring for what we already have builds appreciation and reduces automatic wanting.

missions.title: Money Snapshot
missions.instruction: Check your current balances and available spending money and upcoming commitments.
missions.why: Noticing and caring for what we already have builds appreciation and reduces automatic wanting.

missions.title: Find the Leak

missions.why: Noticing and caring for what we already have builds appreciation and reduces automatic wanting.

missions.title: 24-Hour Pause
missions.instruction: Delay one non-essential purchase for at least 24 hours before deciding.
missions.why: Pausing before choosing strengthens thoughtful decision-making instead of acting on every impulse.

missions.title: Worth It?
missions.instruction: Before one purchase, deliberately decide whether it is worth the cost.
missions.why: Pausing before choosing strengthens thoughtful decision-making instead of acting on every impulse.

missions.title: No-Impulse Day

missions.why: Pausing before choosing strengthens thoughtful decision-making instead of acting on every impulse.

missions.title: Save Something
missions.instruction: Set aside some available money or resources for a future need or goal.
missions.why: Waiting for something worthwhile trains delayed gratification - a core skill behind disciplined choices.

missions.title: Don't Touch It
missions.instruction: Leave money or resources you have already decided to save untouched.
missions.why: Waiting for something worthwhile trains delayed gratification - a core skill behind disciplined choices.

missions.title: Give Savings a Purpose
missions.instruction: Choose one future need or goal and put something toward it today.
missions.why: Waiting for something worthwhile trains delayed gratification - a core skill behind disciplined choices.

missions.title: Look Ahead
missions.instruction: Identify the biggest expected financial needs or purchases coming up soon.
missions.why: Planning ahead helps today's choices support tomorrow's needs instead of leaving everything to the moment.

missions.title: One Money Goal
missions.instruction: Choose one financial goal and define the next concrete step toward it.
missions.why: Planning ahead helps today's choices support tomorrow's needs instead of leaving everything to the moment.

missions.title: Prepare Early
missions.instruction: Take one action today toward an expense or purchase you know is coming.
missions.why: Planning ahead helps today's choices support tomorrow's needs instead of leaving everything to the moment.

missions.title: Spend With Purpose
missions.instruction: Review one meaningful expense and ask whether it reflects what matters most.
missions.why: Using resources carefully builds respect for value and the habit of avoiding unnecessary waste.

missions.title: Future-You Test
missions.instruction: Before one meaningful money decision, consider how it may affect you later.
missions.why: Using resources carefully builds respect for value and the habit of avoiding unnecessary waste.

missions.title: Use It Well

missions.why: Using resources carefully builds respect for value and the habit of avoiding unnecessary waste.

missions.title: Notice Yourself

missions.why: Noticing feelings, needs and behaviour builds self-awareness - the starting point for better choices.

missions.title: Five-Minute Reflection
missions.instruction: Spend five quiet minutes reflecting on one choice you made today and its effect.
missions.why: Noticing feelings, needs and behaviour builds self-awareness - the starting point for better choices.

missions.title: Spot the Pattern
missions.instruction: Identify one situation that repeatedly triggers an unhelpful response or behaviour from you.
missions.why: Noticing feelings, needs and behaviour builds self-awareness - the starting point for better choices.

missions.title: Keep One Promise

missions.title: Do It Anyway

missions.why: Following through on small personal responsibilities strengthens self-discipline and trust in yourself.

missions.title: Important Before Easy

missions.title: Own It

missions.title: Values Check

missions.title: Reset Before Reply
